seed: Long form of the speed walk on the 60 minute reference edit: the playhead dragged end to end slow, medium and fling, the timeline zoomed and scrolled end to end, a minute played across its transitions, the edits made while it plays, and then ten minutes of playing with a hand taking the playhead somewhere else every half minute while memory is read once a second. Opening it alone took about 140 seconds on 2026-11-12. Run by Scripts/perf/speed-walk.sh --long.
